prompt: Create an original photorealistic cinematic car chase using a structured Blender-to-PixVerse workflow. Design two cars, a driver and an urban environment. Create three connected 4-second shots with a rear pursuit, side tracking turn and wide exit. Animate and validate vehicle movement, wheel rotation, steering, driver interaction and camera paths in Blender. Render a 12-second 1280×720 gray-model video. Use PixVerse Plugin and Seedance 2.5 to create cinematic reference images from the corresponding first frames, preserving composition, perspective and vehicle identity. Use those references with the Blender videos to generate each shot while maintaining the original camera movement, trajectories, timing, colors and spatial relationships.

post.originalText:
The goal wasn't to ask AI to invent an entire car chase.
The motion was designed and tested in Blender first, then PixVerse was used to turn that structure into photorealistic cinematic footage.
Made by PixVerse. The PixVerse Plugin connects the creative stages.

translations.zh: 使用结构化的 Blender 到 PixVerse 工作流创建原创逼真的电影级汽车追逐场景。设计两辆车、一名驾驶员和城市环境。创建包含后方追逐、侧面追踪转弯和宽景离开的三个连续4秒镜头。在 Blender 中制作并验证车辆运动、车轮旋转、转向、驾驶员互动和摄像机路径。渲染一段12秒、1280×720的灰模视频。使用 PixVerse 插件和 Seedance 2.5 根据首帧创建电影参考图，保持构图、视角和车辆特征。将参考图结合 Blender 视频生成各个镜头，同时保持原有摄像机运动、轨迹、时序、色彩和空间关系。
